function.name: check_calendar_availability
function.description: Checks the clinic's calendar for available appointment slots based on patient preferences.

date.description: The date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, defaults to today.
date.title: Date

provider_id.description: The specific provider ID to check availability for. If not provided, checks any provider.
provider_id.title: Provider Id

service_type.description: The type of service requested, e.g. 'consult', 'cleaning', 'surgery'
service_type.title: Service Type

function.name: book_new_appointment
function.description: Books a new appointment for the patient and securely logs their details.

patient_name.description: The full name of the patient.
patient_name.title: Patient Name

phone.description: The 10-digit phone number of the patient.
phone.title: Phone

dob.description: The date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.
dob.title: Dob

slot_id.description: The specific slot ID provided by the check_calendar_availability tool.
slot_id.title: Slot Id

reason.description: The reason for the visit or any additional notes.
reason.title: Reason

function.name: cancel_existing_appointment
function.description: Cancels an existing appointment after verifying the patient's identity.

phone.description: The patient's phone number for verification.
phone.title: Phone

dob.description: The patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format for verification.
dob.title: Dob

appointment_date.description: The date of the appointment they wish to cancel, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
appointment_date.title: Appointment Date

reason.description: The reason for cancelling the appointment.
reason.title: Reason

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedules an existing appointment to a new slot.

phone.description: The patient's phone number for verification.
phone.title: Phone

dob.description: The patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format for verification.
dob.title: Dob

old_appointment_date.description: The date of the current appointment they wish to change, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
old_appointment_date.title: Old Appointment Date

new_slot_id.description: The new slot ID to move the appointment to.
new_slot_id.title: New Slot Id

function.name: add_to_waitlist
function.description: Adds a patient to the clinic's waitlist if their desired time slot is unavailable.

preferred_day.description: The preferred day of the week, e.g. 'Monday', 'Friday', or 'any'.
preferred_day.title: Preferred Day

preferred_time_range.description: The preferred time of day: 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening', or 'any'.
preferred_time_range.title: Preferred Time Range

function.name: log_patient_symptoms
function.description: Logs the patient's symptoms or clinical notes securely.

phone.description: The 10-digit phone number of the patient.
phone.title: Phone

symptom_summary.description: A concise summary of the patient's symptoms.
symptom_summary.title: Symptom Summary

function.name: check_existing_patient
function.description: Checks if a patient already exists in the system using their phone number.

phone.description: The 10-digit phone number of the caller.
phone.title: Phone

function.name: send_live_sms_link
function.description: Sends an SMS to the patient with a link (e.g. intake form or directions) while they are on the phone.

phone.description: The 10-digit phone number of the patient.
phone.title: Phone

link_type.description: Type of link to send. Usually 'intake_form', 'payment_url', 'address_map', or 'confirmation_page'
link_type.title: Link Type

function.name: transfer_call_to_human
function.description: Transfers the ongoing call to a human receptionist or staff member.

function.name: check_service_pricing
function.description: Checks the price and duration of a specific service offered by the clinic.

service_name.description: The name of the service the patient is asking about (e.g. 'consult', 'teeth whitening', 'botox')
service_name.title: Service Name

function.name: get_clinic_faq
function.description: Gets answers to frequently asked questions about the clinic.

question_type.description: A short keyword describing the question category (e.g., 'parking', 'location', 'insurance', 'cancellation')
question_type.title: Question Type
